summary: Fire lookout planned in 1912 and staffed into the 1950s; the tower is gone, and a hiker's log describes foundations at the summit.

facts.design: steel tower with stairs and glass-enclosed cab (CCC, 1936)
facts.status_note: No longer standing. A hiker's log quoted on a forum describes foundations and a fire warden's cabin at the summit.

notes_for_editor: Removal date and cause are not in our sources. A NorthWoods Stewardship Center page (northwoodscenter.org, post 1828) reportedly says the Gore and Spruce towers were removed while the cabins stand; it returned 403 to our reader, so it is not cited. Do not confuse with New York's Gore Mountain in Warren County, a different lookout. Watchman names come from newspaper items quoted on the Forest Lookouts page. The 1924 steel tower and the 1936 CCC tower may or may not be the same structure; the 1936 entry says only that it replaced an old tower. The 1968 NGS text is quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; we did not open the NGS datasheet itself. The hiker's log is undated and comes from a forum post, so the summit description is low-weight.
